- What are the best activities in Marbella?



There are so many great things to do in Marbella! Of course, you can't beat spending a day at the beach. Marbella has some of the best beaches in Spain, with soft sand and crystal-clear water. For a little excitement, try jet skiing or parasailing. And for a more relaxing experience, head to one of the many beach clubs and enjoy a delicious meal with a view.

- What are the best villa rentals in Marbella?

- What are the advantages of renting a house or a villa in Marbella



Renting a villa in Marbella can be a great way to experience the city like a local. You'll have more space and privacy than a hotel, and you can often find villas with private pools and gardens. This is especially great for families or groups of friends, as you can have your own space to relax and enjoy each other's company.

- What food festivals or culinary events take place in and around Marbella?



Marbella hosts several food festivals throughout the year, celebrating the region's delicious cuisine. The most popular is the Feria de San Bernabé in June, which features traditional Andalusian food and music. There's also the Marbella Gastronomy Week in October, which showcases the best restaurants in the city.

- What are the best villa rentals with a jacuzzi in Marbella?

For a truly luxurious experience, you can book a private yacht charter and explore the stunning coastline. Or, if you're a golf enthusiast, you can play at one of Marbella's world-class golf courses. For a more unique experience, take a private cooking class and learn how to prepare some of the region's most famous dishes.

- Which part of Marbella would be ideal for a villa rental?



The Golden Mile is a popular area for villa rentals, as it's close to the beach and all the action. If you're looking for something a bit quieter, the area around Nueva Andalucia is a good choice. For a more traditional experience, you could rent a villa in the Old Town.

## Travel guide

### A quick overview of Marbella

Marbella is a lively resort city in the Costa del Sol. This popular party destination is a playground for the rich and famous and the perfect location for a sun-drenched escape in beautiful surroundings. Marbella boasts mild Mediterranean climate, Michelin-starred restaurants, a world-class nightlife, luxury shopping brands and some of the best golf courses Europe. Temperatures in summer rarely go over 30°C, and in winter rarely drop below 12°C. Average sea temperature in summer is at a pleasant 24°C.

### Key holiday info

- Marbella is 40 minutes from the nearest Málaga airport which is less than a 3 hour direct flight from the UK and mainland Europe.
- During the height of summer you can expect the highest daytime temperature to reach 30°C, whilst the winter is colder with daytime highs rarely falling below 12°C.
- The average summer sea temperature is 24°C.
- There are 10 golf courses in Marbella area alone and over 50 along the Costa del Sol.
- Marbella boasts 5 Blue Flag beaches: Guadalmina, Casablanca, Faro, El Cable and Artola.

### How to get to Marbella

Marbella is just 40 minutes from Málaga airport which is less than a 3 hour direct flight from the UK and mainland Europe. Taxis from terminal three are readily available to take you right to your accommodation at costs from 50 Euros . Buses and coaches are also plentiful and considerably cheaper.

### Where to stay in Marbella

Plenty of smaller resort areas between Sitio de Calahonda and Puerto Banus to choose from for a great holiday. If you fancy yourself a night owl and are looking for a rather vibrant holiday destination, with lots of bars and nightclubs, then Marbella it is. Puerto Banus, 10 kilometres west from Marbella, is also quite buzzy. It’s the hub for celebrities worldwide during summer - big yachts, expensive cars and bling. On the other hand, Sitio de Calahonda is a quiet resort with fine sand beaches and several golf courses strewn around it.

### Beaches in Marbella

With a 27km-long coastline, Marbella boasts 24 different beaches, many of which have received the prestigious Blue Flag Award over the years. From **Capobino** to **San Pedro Alcantara**, take your pick and relax! With an abundance of water sports facilities, stretches of golden sand and azure calm waters, Marbella's beaches are a perfect base to chill out, spend time with family, exercise, or party from dusk till dawn. Among the most popular are: **Capobino**, **Nueva Andalucia**, **Alicate**, **Puerto Banús**, **Artola**, **Fontanilla** and **Nikki** beach. Enjoy the full 5-star Marbella experience and live the life of luxury from one of our spacious villa rentals with private pools.

### Golf courses in Marbella

Marbella is one of the best golf destinations in Europe. With over 10 golf courses in Marbella alone and over 50 along the Costa del Sol, there’s a great variety and choice when it comes to the game of golf. **Sotogrande** is one of the best golf courses in southern Spain. Located under an hour from Marbella, this 18 hole course stretches its greens across 6700 metres. **Marbella Golf Country Club** is also an excellent choice. Natural rolling hills of the course make shots tricky and interesting, especially with risky bunkers and water hazards. Of course, you can never go wrong with **Guadalmina Golf Club**, which less than 20 minutes from Marbella. There are two courses here - north and south. The northern course was opened in 1973 and has a slightly less challenging layout than the southern. Both courses are in brilliant condition, and there is a restaurant and a cafe at the club.

### Things to do in Marbella

Art lovers might appreciate a visit to **Avenida del Mar**, exhibiting Dalí's sculptures and temporary art and media. If that's not enough, then get your cultural fix at the **Spanish Contemporary Engraving Museum** in the Hospital Bazán - the most important museum of its kind and home to the exhibitions of engravings and art works from national artists such as Picasso and Miró. But Marbella still retains a traditional Andalucian charm. In the heart of the historic old quarter lies the famous **Plaza de Naranja**; otherwise known as Orange Square, set in a beautiful bay with whitewashed houses and orange trees embellishing its ancient streets. The town’s jewel, well worth a visit, is the 16th century **Church of Our Lady of the Incarnation** that stands out as an exquisite piece of architecture. Step back in time with archaeological sites like the **Roman baths of San Pedro**, or walk down the 300 steps leading to **Casa del Rey Moro** fortress and water mine, with the singing birds and lapping water providing a peaceful soundtrack. Cross the road from the Old Town and you’ll find yourself at **La Alameda Park**. With a large ceramic fountain surrounded by exotic plants and trees, the park is a true oasis of peace, where you can enjoy some shade from the midday sun.

### Activities for kids in Marbella

With its exuberant nightlife, Marbella city and the resort are perfect for an upbeat, energetic holiday with friends. Marbella is okay for families as well but some nearby resorts, like Sitio de Calahonda or Estepona, might be a better choice. Apart from beach activities, shopping and occasional visits to fast food joints there aren’t many activities that will keep the kids occupied here. However, **Selwo Aventura** is an animal park north-east from Estepona. The park has quite the animal collection and they offer walking and vehicle tours of the park which kids find amusing. There is also an excellent water park in Fuengirola called **Aquamijas** with wave pools, water slides, play area and snack food bars.

### Getting around Marbella

If you’re planning on staying in the city and not venturing outside that much, then you should be fine on foot. Marbella city isn’t large and most amenities, including parks and shops, can be found nearby. Taxis and car hire are always an option if you’re planning a trip outside the city, but may cost an arm and a leg. However, CTSA-Portillo transportation company is inexpensive and has regular lines between Malaga and Algeciras. Purchasing a ‘Bonobus’ card is much cheaper than buying single tickets, and minimum recharge for the card is 5 Euros.

### Where to eat in Marbella

Marbella has plenty of places to eat and drink, from cheap fast food joints and upscale restaurants dotted along the Paseo Maritimo boulevard, to the lively port promenade where you can sip your favourite drink at one of the many luxury bars, while watching the world go by. The best restaurant in the city must be **Paco Jimenez Restaurant** in the old town, excellent food with a cosy atmosphere. It’s tucked away a bit but definitely worth the effort of finding it. **Bogart's Tapas Bar & Restaurant** in Sitio de Calahonda is inexpensive with cocktails and a great menu that includes various dishes. **Breathe Marbella** in Puerto Banus is an upmarket all-round venue with outstanding food and drinks, atmosphere and shows.

### Nightlife in Marbella

Let your hair down, mingle and dance the night away, with plenty of clubs, bars and venues to choose from. Most night clubs are concentrated in Puerto Banus and Marbella city, with the most popular being **Olivia Valere**, midway between Marbella city to Puerto Banus. There is also a great choice of bars. **Crystal’s Banus** is a premium karaoke bar and an excellent venue with quality drinks. **The Claddagh** is an Irish bar in Torremolinos with live music entertainment, great food and, most important, beer aplenty.

### Shopping in Marbella

Since it’s a playground for the rich and famous, no wonder some of the most prestigious fashion stores can be found right here in Marbella. Forget Paris and New York, everything is here - from **Louis Vuitton** and **Gucci** to **Dior** and **Versace**. There are also some department stores and malls selling everything and anything. **El Corte Ingles** in Puerto Banus sells everything from haberdashery, men’s and women’s clothes, electrical appliances to jewellery, glasses and newspapers. There are also cafes, fast foods and restaurants. **La Canada**, north from Marbella city, is similar plus there is a cinema there.

### Did you know...

- A former mosque, Ermita de Santiago in the centre of Marbella was later transformed into a small church - the oldest one in Marbella!
- Marbella's Bonsai Museum is one of the best in Europe, housing a wonderful collection of exotic Bonsai trees from all over the world.
- Selwo Marina is a small marine park, 30 minutes from Marbella. It is the only park of its kind in Andalusia.
- Have a laugh with friends at Funny Beach, an amusement park just outside of Marbella, with go karts, parasailing, water scooters and a restaurant bar!
- The Sierra de las Nieves Natural Park, approx. 1 hour away, was declared a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in 1995.

## Marbella Travel Guide

Click to Expand

## Mediterranean Glamour Meets Andalusian Charm

Marbella is where timeless elegance, sun-drenched days, and modern luxury collide. Nestled on Spain’s Costa del Sol, Marbella has long been a playground for royalty, celebrities, and discerning travelers who seek more than just a beach holiday. With its blend of Andalusian culture, world-class cuisine, golden beaches, and exclusive estates, Marbella offers the perfect balance of relaxation, sophistication, and excitement.

This guide will help you explore the best of Marbella—from when to visit and what to experience, to why Isle Blue’s luxury villas offer the ultimate way to enjoy this iconic destination.

### When to Visit Marbella

Marbella enjoys over 320 days of sunshine a year, making it an ideal year-round destination.

- **Spring (March to May):** Mild temperatures, blooming landscapes, and fewer crowds. Perfect for sightseeing, beach walks, and golf.

- **Summer (June to August):** Peak season with hot days, buzzing nightlife, and a vibrant social scene. Beach clubs and events are in full swing.

- **Autumn (September to November):** Warm days, quieter beaches, and ideal conditions for dining al fresco and cultural exploration.

- **Winter (December to February):** A mild and peaceful time to enjoy Marbella’s old town charm, mountain hikes, and luxurious villa living without the bustle.


### Where to Stay – Isle Blue’s Marbella Villas

Our Marbella villa collection features the finest properties in the region, located in exclusive neighborhoods like Sierra Blanca, La Zagaleta, Nueva Andalucía, and the Golden Mile. Each villa is chosen for its privacy, comfort, and architectural beauty—offering private pools, panoramic terraces, luxury interiors, and easy access to Marbella’s beaches, golf courses, and vibrant town life.

Whether you’re looking for a sleek modern estate overlooking the sea or a classic Spanish hacienda with lush gardens, Isle Blue villas provide an elevated Marbella experience. Many villas come with full staffing options, including private chefs, housekeepers, and butlers for a seamless, resort-style stay.

### What to Do in Marbella – Signature Experiences

**Stroll the Old Town (Casco Antiguo)**

Wander through cobbled streets, orange-scented plazas, and whitewashed buildings. Discover local boutiques, tapas bars, and the iconic Plaza de los Naranjos.

**Enjoy the Beach Clubs**

Spend the day at Marbella’s renowned beach clubs like Nikki Beach, Ocean Club, or La Cabane. Relax in a private cabana, sip chilled rosé, and soak up the sun in true Mediterranean style.

**Play Championship Golf**

With over 70 golf courses in the Costa del Sol, Marbella is a golfer’s paradise. Courses like Los Naranjos, Aloha Golf Club, and Real Club de Golf Las Brisas are just minutes from many villas.

**Sail the Mediterranean**

Charter a private yacht from Puerto Banús and explore the stunning coastline. Swim in secluded coves, spot dolphins, or cruise to nearby destinations like Sotogrande or Malaga.

**Dine in Style**

Marbella’s dining scene ranges from Michelin-starred restaurants to seaside chiringuitos. Top spots include Dani García’s Bibo, Nobu Marbella, and Skina in the Old Town. Private chefs are also available to craft gourmet experiences in the comfort of your villa.

**Day Trips and Cultural Exploration**

Take a day trip to Ronda’s dramatic cliffs and wineries, explore the historic Alhambra in Granada, or experience the vibrant culture of Seville or Córdoba—all just a few hours’ drive away.

**Wellness and Relaxation**

Unwind with yoga on your villa terrace, book a private massage or facial, or visit one of Marbella’s renowned wellness spas for a rejuvenating experience.

### Plan Your Stay with Isle Blue

With Isle Blue, every Marbella villa stay includes complimentary concierge service to help you plan the perfect trip. We’ll assist with airport transfers, restaurant reservations, yacht charters, and more. From romantic escapes and wellness retreats to milestone celebrations, we tailor every detail to your desires.

Plus, our loyalty rewards program lets you earn points with each booking—redeemable for future stays and exclusive enhancements.

### **Start Your Marbella Escape**

Marbella is more than a destination—it’s a way of life. Relaxed yet refined. Classic yet cosmopolitan. Let Isle Blue introduce you to the finest in Costa del Sol living with a luxury villa stay tailored entirely to you.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is Marbella Mountain Resorts?

Marbella Mountain Resorts is a boutique luxury villa rental company specialising in ultra-exclusive private residences across Marbella, Andalucía, and the Costa del Sol. Unlike third-party platforms, we manage every villa directly on behalf of its owners, delivering the attentiveness and standards of a boutique five-star hotel group — with the intimacy and discretion of a private home. Our curated portfolio spans some of Southern Spain’s most coveted addresses, from the sovereign estate of La Zagaleta to the iconic seafront of the Golden Mile.

#### Why choose Marbella Mountain Resorts over other agencies?

Where other platforms aggregate listings from thousands of anonymous owners, Marbella Mountain Resorts operates an exclusively managed, hand-selected portfolio of no more than 30 residences. Every villa is personally inspected by our on-the-ground team before your arrival. Every enquiry is answered by a dedicated specialist — not a chatbot. And every stay is supported by our 24/7 concierge team, available to arrange private chefs, helicopter transfers, yacht charters, and bespoke experiences. We do not simply list properties; we curate and host extraordinary stays. We live in Marbella, and we understand luxury.

#### What types of luxury villas can I rent through Marbella Mountain Resorts?

Our collection ranges from architecturally striking contemporary estates to timeless Andalusian cortijos, set across Marbella’s most exclusive enclaves — including La Zagaleta, Sierra Blanca, Cascada de Camoján, the Golden Mile, Puente Romano, and Nueva Andalucía. Villas sleep from 8 to 26 guests and feature heated infinity pools, panoramic Mediterranean sea views, private cinema rooms, professional-grade kitchens, and multi-car garages. Extended long-term rentals are also available for guests who wish to immerse themselves fully in the Marbella lifestyle.

#### How do I book a luxury villa with Marbella Mountain Resorts?

We believe the booking experience should be as refined as the stay itself. Simply contact our team by phone, WhatsApp, or email — available 24 hours a day, seven days a week — to share your travel dates, group size, and any specific preferences. A dedicated villa specialist will personally guide you through the most suitable residences, arrange a private viewing if desired, and ensure every detail is agreed upon before confirming your reservation. We do not charge third-party booking fees; you always receive the best available rate directly with us.

#### Is my booking secure when renting a villa directly with Marbella Mountain Resorts?

Absolutely. Because we manage all properties exclusively and operate without intermediaries, you are dealing directly with the authorised rental management team for each villa. Our booking process is fully transparent — all conditions, included services, and pricing are confirmed in writing before any payment is made. Our guests book with complete confidence, knowing there are no hidden fees or last-minute surprises, and that a dedicated point of contact is available at every stage of their journey.

#### What services and amenities are included in a luxury villa rental?

Each villa comes pre-inspected and fully prepared for your arrival. Standard inclusions vary by property but typically encompass professional linens and towels, high-speed WiFi, air conditioning, and a fully equipped kitchen. Optional premium services — including a live-in private chef, daily housekeeping, in-villa spa therapies, personal shopping, private security, and a dedicated concierge — can be arranged to transform your villa into a truly five-star residence. We also coordinate transfers by private jet, helicopter, or chauffeur-driven vehicle, ensuring your Marbella experience begins the moment you land.

#### When is the best time to visit Marbella for a luxury villa holiday?

Marbella enjoys over 300 days of sunshine annually, making it one of Europe’s most appealing year-round destinations. The peak season of July and August brings a vibrant, high-energy atmosphere with beach clubs, international events, and long golden evenings. For those who prefer a more intimate experience, late May through June and September through October offer warm temperatures, quieter roads, impeccable golf weather, and the unhurried elegance of a destination at its most authentic. The winter months are increasingly popular among guests seeking extended long-term stays, wellness retreats, and the tranquil beauty of the Sierra Blanca mountains.

#### Can I stay long-term or work remotely from your villas?

Marbella Mountain Resorts specializes in extended luxury stays, offering villas with offices, high-speed internet, wellness areas, and everything needed for remote work or relocation to Marbella.

#### What is the minimum rental period for a luxury villa in Marbella?

Most villas have a minimum stay of 7 nights, depending on the season and property. We also offer monthly and seasonal rentals for clients looking for a second-home experience in Marbella.

Discover why discerning travellers worldwide choose us for luxury villa holidays in Marbella and unforgettable Costa del Sol experiences. Contact us today to begin planning your dream Mediterranean escape.
